policy: A dedicated target-native dependency prefix is required. Never use an arbitrary installed OpenConnect. Prefix must contain shared libraries and share/licenses with dependency copyright/license texts. Versions and staged file SHA256 values are recorded in each output manifest. This file constrains capability minima, not a claim that transitive dependency sources have been version-locked.

crypto.nettle_public_key: hogweed with GMP, not a missing optional dependency

windows: MSYS2 Python >=3.10 with tarfile data_filter backport
